# Aniah’s Collection

> Aniah’s Collection sells Ankara fabrics and styles, joggers for men and women, and jewelry, with delivery across Nigeria.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Shop Ankara fabrics and styles, joggers for men and women, and jewelry from Aniah’s Collection. Pay by bank transfer, delivery across Nigeria.
- [Shop](/shop.html): Browse all Ankara prints, men’s and women’s joggers and jewelry. Order online and pay by bank transfer.
- [Size guide](/size-guide.html): Find your jogger size by waist and height. Size charts in cm and inches for men and women.
- [Blog](/blog.html): Style tips, fabric guides and news from Aniah’s Collection.
